macros.name: intersubproofvertspace
macros.doc: An extra vertical space of length \intersubproofvertspace is added after each statement in the proof.

macros.name: subproofhorizspace
macros.doc: The horizontal distance between the sides of nested boxes is the length stored in \subproofhorizspace.

envs.name: logicproof
envs.doc: The logicproof environment takes a single argument, which should be a nonnegative integer describing the maximum number of nested subproofs that this proof will contain.
